title: "When you play me from face down on your turn, you may move an enemy unit at a different location to my battlefield" never triggers.
expected: Card def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/evelynn-entrancing.ts:29-33) uses trigger {event:"play-from-hidden", on:"self"}. revealHidden in game-definition/moves/play/hide.ts:356-361 fires only {type:"play-self", fromHiddenAt} and {type:"play-card"}; grep shows no emitter of "play-from-hidden" anywhere in engine src (only a test comment in __tests__/cards/ogn-167-298.test.ts:69 acknowledging the gap). trigger-matcher.ts EVENT_MAP (87-118) has no play-from-hidden entry and triggerMatchesEvent (213-230) only aliases beginning-phase/recycle-cards-to-deck/typed play-<cardType>, so a play-self event never matches a "play-from-hidden" trigger. The ability can never fire.
observed: revealHidden succeeded (Evelynn entered battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-275-298 exhausted) but chain=null, pendingChoice=null, no opt-in prompt, and the enemy unit stayed in base. Root cause in engine: revealHidden (moves/play/hide.ts) fires only 'play-self' (with fromHiddenAt) and 'play-card' events; nothing ever emits a 'play-from-hidden' event and trigger-matcher EVENT_MAP has no entry for it, so the card's trigger {event:"play-from-hidden", on:"self"} can never match.
